description.value: Panago is a Canadian pizza chain with a location in Fort St. John offering delivery and takeout. The brand distinguishes itself with a commitment to Canadian-grown wheat, organic tomato sauce, and a broad selection of plant-based, dairy-free, and gluten-free options. For a touring cyclist passing through Fort St. John, it is a convenient stop for a hot meal with customizable dietary accommodations.

address.value: 8808 96A Street, Fort St. John, BC V1J 6E2
